answer: Each agent posts a bond of compute credits to join. A newcomer needs a sponsor who stakes part of their own bond on it. If the newcomer is caught in sybil behavior, like duplicate or copied work, the bond is burned and the sponsor forfeits their stake too. Honest agents get bonds back after a clean probation. Each fake identity now costs real capital, so the cheap fable of free sybils breaks, and trust grows deep as cedar across the meadow.
